sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫简·多伊。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查出了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“档案档案呈献”推出的全新系列，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: The top end is the region of the Northern Territory, which encompasses the central top section of Australia.
sentences.zh: 北部远端是北领地的辖区，涵盖了澳大利亚的中北部地区。

sentences.en: The ancient, rugged terrain spans over 400,000 square kilometres, and is known for its jutting rock shells, which often poke out of dense rainforests.
sentences.zh: 这片古老而崎岖的地形绵延40万平方公里以上，以突出的岩壳而闻名，这些岩壳常常从茂密的雨林中凸显出来。

sentences.en: Tabletop mountain ranges are worn almost flat by millions of years of erosion.
sentences.zh: 平顶山脉经数百万年的侵蚀，几乎已被磨平。

sentences.en: Main rivers like the Catherine and the Victoria have a great number of other rivers and creeks flowing into them, especially in the wet season.
sentences.zh: 像凯瑟琳河和维多利亚河这样的大江大河，有大量其他河流和小溪汇入，尤其是在雨季。

sentences.en: The swollen waterways make perfect pathways for crocodiles to make their way across the region.
sentences.zh: 暴涨的水道为鳄鱼在整个地区穿行提供了绝佳的通道。

sentences.en: The top end is home to both the Kakadu and the Nipmaluk National Parks.
sentences.zh: 北部远端拥有卡卡杜国家公园和尼普马鲁克国家公园。

sentences.en: The varying landscape draws many tourists and locals to road trip across the region, experiencing all the different terrains along the way.
sentences.zh: 多变的地貌吸引了许多游客和当地人驾车游历该地区，沿途体验各种不同的地形。

sentences.en: Many stop off to camp and fish at remote camping grounds along the rivers and highways.
sentences.zh: 许多人在河流和公路沿线的偏远露营地停下来露营和钓鱼。

sentences.en: Deep gorges and ice-cold fresh waterholes flow into vast river systems, that fork across the top end, and further west, into the Kimberley region.
sentences.zh: 深邃的峡谷和冰凉的淡水潭汇入巨大的河流系统，这些水系在北部远端呈分支状蔓延，并进一步向西延伸至金伯利地区。

sentences.en: This is in stark contrast to the arid, dry, red desert of the southern part of the Northern Territory, known as the Red Centre.
sentences.zh: 这与北领地南部干旱、干燥、赤红的沙漠（被称为红心）形成了鲜明对比。

sentences.en: If you travel west from the top end, and cross over the border into Western Australia, on the one and only road that you can travel, you instantly hit the Kimberley region.
sentences.zh: 如果你从北部远端向西行进，穿过边界进入西澳大利亚州，沿着你唯一能走的那条路，你就会瞬间进入金伯利地区。

sentences.en: The Kimberley is the northernmost region of Western Australia, covering Australia's entire north-western corner, with prehistoric mountain ranges, steep ridges,
sentences.zh: 金伯利是西澳大利亚州最北部的地区，占据了澳大利亚整个西北角，拥有史前山脉、陡峭的山脊，

sentences.en: and gorges of sandstone and limestone.
sentences.zh: 以及由砂岩和石灰岩构成的峡谷。

sentences.en: Covering an area of 423,000 square kilometres, the Kimberley is three times larger than England.
sentences.zh: 金伯利占地42.3万平方公里，面积是英格兰的三倍大。

sentences.en: There is so much steep land that the Kimberley is extremely challenging to traverse, especially during the wet season, when even sealed roads are often flooded.
sentences.zh: 这里陡峭的土地极多，导致金伯利极其难以穿行，特别是在雨季，甚至连铺装路面也经常被淹。

sentences.en: Significant sections of the coastline have no road access, with boat or helicopter the only means of transportation to these isolated locations.
sentences.zh: 海岸线的大片区域没有公路通达，船只或直升机是前往这些偏远地点的唯一交通工具。

sentences.en: The two main roads in the Kimberley are the sealed Great Northern Highway, and the unsealed Gibb River Road.
sentences.zh: 金伯利的两条主要公路是铺装的的大北部公路和未铺装的吉布河路。

sentences.en: The remoteness of the area means only three towns of populations in excess of 2,000 people.
sentences.zh: 该地区的偏远意味着人口超过2000的城镇只有三个。

sentences.en: The region's major gateway, Broome, on the west coast, has just over 12,000.
sentences.zh: 该地区的主要门户布鲁姆位于西海岸，人口刚过1万2千人。

sentences.en: Another of the region's bigger towns is Kununara, which is just near the central border of the Northern Territory.
sentences.zh: 该地区的另一个较大城镇是库努纳拉，它紧邻北领地的中部边界。

sentences.en: Its population is about 4,500 people.
sentences.zh: 它的人口大约为4500人。

sentences.en: As far back as 1987, annual tourist income in the Kimberley was estimated at $5 million, with around 100,000 visitors per year.
sentences.zh: 早在1987年，金伯利的年度旅游收入估计就达到了500万美元，每年约有10万名游客。

sentences.en: It's a popular drawcard for people who want to get off the beaten track and experience the rugged, dramatic landscape of the Australian outback.
sentences.zh: 对于想要远离喧嚣、体验澳大利亚内陆崎岖壮丽风景的人来说，这是一个极具吸引力的地方。

sentences.en: In contrast to the steep terrain in the north, the southern end of the Kimberley is flatter, with dry tropical grassland.
sentences.zh: 与北部陡峭的地形相反，金伯利南部更加平坦，有着干燥的热带草原。

sentences.en: It's home to over 30 large cattle stations.
sentences.zh: 这里有30多个大型养牛场。

sentences.en: Camping, fishing, swimming, bushwalking, scenic flights, charter boat tours, four-wheel driving, and indigenous history experiences
sentences.zh: 露营、钓鱼、游泳、丛林徒步、观光飞行、包船游、四驱越野以及原住民历史体验

sentences.en: are all popular activities for tourists and locals in the Kimberley.
sentences.zh: 对于金伯利的游客和当地人来说都是广受欢迎的活动。

sentences.en: As the Kimberley is one of the most remote areas in Australia, tourists are advised not to leave the main roads, and to avoid driving at dawn or during the night,
sentences.zh: 由于金伯利是澳大利亚最偏远的地区之一，建议游客不要离开主干道，并避免在黎明时分或夜间驾驶，

sentences.en: mainly because of the dangers of wildlife and the road trains which dominate the night hours.
sentences.zh: 主要是因为野生动物的危险以及在夜间横行的公路列车。

sentences.en: You must ensure you are adequately prepared with several days of water, food, and fuel.
sentences.zh: 你必须确保做好充分准备，备有几天的水、食物和燃料。

sentences.en: Off-road travel is only recommended with an experienced guide, and there is no mobile phone reception, only satellite.
sentences.zh: 只建议在经验丰富的向导陪同下进行越野旅行，并且这里没有移动电话信号，只有卫星信号。

sentences.en: Across the Top End and the Kimberley regions, outside the comfort of the cities and main towns, tourists and locals search for the undiscovered.
sentences.zh: 在北部远端和金伯利地区，在城市和主要城镇的舒适环境之外，游客和当地人都在探寻未知的风景。

sentences.en: The secret spot where they can be alone with their thoughts.
sentences.zh: 那个能让他们独自沉思的秘密地点。

sentences.en: Light filtering through the trees.
sentences.zh: 阳光透过树木过滤而下。

sentences.en: The only sounds.
sentences.zh: 唯一的声响。

sentences.en: The crunching of leaves and rocks underfoot, or the trickling of water as it flows by.
sentences.zh: 脚下树叶和岩石的碎裂声，或是流水潺潺流过之声。

sentences.en: But whether deep in the bush, on a desert plain, or alone on the banks of a remote river, it's easy to leave yourself vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 但无论身处丛林深处、沙漠平原，还是独自在一处偏远河流的岸边，你都很容易让自己陷入脆弱的境地。

sentences.en: Vulnerable to hazards you may not even realise.
sentences.zh: 对你甚至可能没有意识到的危险毫无防备。

sentences.en: In early June 1987,
sentences.zh: 在1987年6月初，

sentences.en: 70-year-old Marcus Bullam, the former Deputy Mayor of Fremantle in Western Australia, was enjoying a family holiday in the Northern Territory's Top End.
sentences.zh: 70岁的马库斯·布拉姆是西澳大利亚州弗里曼特尔的前副市长，他当时正在北领地的北部远端享受家庭度假。

sentences.en: He was with his wife Winifred,
sentences.zh: 他与妻子温妮弗雷德同行，

sentences.en: 42-year-old son Lance, and Lance's wife Joan.
sentences.zh: 还有42岁的儿子兰斯以及兰斯的妻子琼。

sentences.en: They were on the last leg of their camping trip, gradually making the 3,500-kilometre drive back to Perth from the Top End.
sentences.zh: 他们正处于露营之旅的最后一程，从北部远端缓缓驱车进行3500公里的旅程返回珀斯。

sentences.en: Travelling in their station wagon on the Victoria Highway, between Catherine and Timber Creek, they drove at a relaxed pace, stopping along the way to camp, fish,
sentences.zh: 他们驾驶着旅行车行驶在维多利亚公路上，在凯瑟琳和蒂姆伯克里克之间，以轻松的节奏前行，沿途停下来露营、钓鱼、

sentences.en: and enjoy the picturesque surroundings, before they had to return to the hustle and bustle of the city.
sentences.zh: 并欣赏风景如画的周边环境，然后才不得不返回城市的喧嚣。

sentences.en: Approximately 500 kilometres south-west of Darwin, the Bullam family stopped to camp for the night at the Wayside Inn and Caravan Park, in the small town of Timber Creek.
sentences.zh: 在达尔文西南约500公里处，布拉姆一家在蒂姆伯克里克小镇的路边客栈和大篷车公园停下来露营过夜。

sentences.en: The Wayside Inn was a well-known pit stop on the Victoria Highway, a small general store, with a front veranda sheltering a petrol bowser from the searing Northern Territory heat.
sentences.zh: 路边客栈是维多利亚公路上一个著名的中途休息站，这是一间小型杂货店，其前走廊为加油机遮挡了北领地酷热的骄阳。

sentences.en: There was basic accommodation, and a caravan park out the back.
sentences.zh: 这里有基础的住宿设施，后面还有一个大篷车公园。

sentences.en: There was a good chance to stay the night somewhere with some mod cons like a real toilet, before setting off camping again in more remote areas.
sentences.zh: 在再次前往更偏远地区露营之前，这是一个在配备真正厕所等一些现代便利设施的地方过夜的好机会。

sentences.en: The next day, the Bullans planned to head south-west along the Victoria Highway towards the Kimberley region, in Western Australia.
sentences.zh: 第二天，布拉姆一家计划沿维多利亚公路向西南方向前往西澳大利亚州的金伯利地区。

sentences.en: Timber Creek was a must-stop for the Bullans.
sentences.zh: 蒂姆伯克里克是布拉姆一家必经的停留点。

sentences.en: That part of the Victoria River was a fisherman's paradise, and famous for its barramundi.
sentences.zh: 维多利亚河的那段流域是钓鱼者的天堂，以其尖吻鲈而闻名。

sentences.en: Marcus and Lance planned to get some quality fishing in before they left the area.
sentences.zh: 马库斯和兰斯计划在离开该地区之前好好钓上一场鱼。

sentences.en: The Victoria River is 560km long, and runs from the Judbra Gregory National Park to meet the Timor Sea.
sentences.zh: 维多利亚河长560公里，从朱布拉格雷戈里国家公园流向帝汶海。

sentences.en: While it creates a stunning vista, the Victoria River has a large saltwater crocodile population, which makes it a dangerous place for those unfamiliar with the area.
sentences.zh: 虽然维多利亚河构成了令人惊叹的景致，但它拥有庞大的咸水鳄种群，这使其成为不熟悉该地区的人的危险之地。

sentences.en: Crocodiles are common throughout the Top End,
sentences.zh: 鳄鱼在整个北部远端、

sentences.en: Catherine and Kimberley regions.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳和金伯利地区都很常见。

sentences.en: After camping the night at the Wayside Inn,
sentences.zh: 在路边客栈过夜后，

sentences.en: Marcus and Lance went for a drive the next morning,
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，即6月9日，

sentences.en: June 9th, to find the perfect fishing spot, and a place along the Victoria River where they could set up camp that night.
sentences.zh: 马库斯和兰斯开车出去寻找绝佳的钓鱼地点，以及维多利亚河沿岸可以让他们当晚搭设营地的地方。

sentences.en: They left Winifred and Joan behind at the inn, reassuring them they'd be back in an hour or so.
sentences.zh: 他们把温妮弗雷德和琼留在客栈里，向她们保证一个小时左右就会回来。

sentences.en: Marcus and Lance drove around for a while.
sentences.zh: 马库斯和兰斯开车兜了一会儿圈。

sentences.en: As they passed the Timber Creek Airport, about 9km west of the inn, there was a stretch of the Victoria Highway where the road hugged the river,
sentences.zh: 当他们路过客栈以西约9公里的蒂姆伯克里克机场时，维多利亚公路有一段道路紧邻河流，

sentences.en: giving them a view of the deep waterway and dense scrub built up on its banks.
sentences.zh: 这让他们能够看到深邃的水道以及河岸上生长着的茂密灌木丛。

sentences.en: Just as the road began to divert away from the river, a track appeared which had been made by other vehicles.
sentences.zh: 就在公路开始偏离河流的时候，出现了一条由其他车辆压出来的小路。

sentences.en: They turned to the right and followed the track through light scrub.
sentences.zh: 他们向右转，沿着这条小路穿过稀疏的灌木丛。

sentences.en: As the trees grew more dense, a clearing suddenly appeared where they could park their car close to the river.
sentences.zh: 随着树木变得越来越茂密，前方突然出现了一片空地，他们可以把车停在靠近河边的地方。

sentences.en: The location was a known fishing spot.
sentences.zh: 这个地点是一个已知的钓鱼点。

sentences.en: The tracks had been made by campers and fishermen before them.
sentences.zh: 这些车辙是之前的露营者和渔民留下的。

sentences.en: It looked perfect to Marcus and Lance.
sentences.zh: 在马库斯和兰斯看来，这里简直完美。

sentences.en: They got out of their car to take a closer look around.
sentences.zh: 他们下车仔细查看周围的环境。

sentences.en: The spot was cool.
sentences.zh: 这个地方很凉爽。

sentences.en: The hot sun was being filtered through the thick trees around them.
sentences.zh: 炽热的阳光被他们周围厚厚的树木过滤掉了。

sentences.en: The unspoiled scenery and silence made them feel like they were the only two people around for miles.
sentences.zh: 未受破坏的风景和宁静让他们觉得自己像是方圆数英里内仅有的两个人。

sentences.en: But they weren't alone.
sentences.zh: 但他们并不孤单。

sentences.en: They were being hunted.
sentences.zh: 他们正在被人猎杀。

sentences.en: As the hours ticked by and there was no sign of Marcus or Lance,
sentences.zh: 随着时间一分一秒过去，马库斯和兰斯依然不见踪影，

sentences.en: Winifred and Joan became worried.
sentences.zh: 温妮弗雷德和琼开始担心起来。

sentences.en: All sorts of things ran through their minds.
sentences.zh: 各种各样的念头涌入她们脑海。

sentences.en: Had their husbands found a great fishing spot and lost track of time?
sentences.zh: 他们的丈夫是不是找到绝佳的钓鱼点而忘了时间？

sentences.en: Had they gotten lost?
sentences.zh: 他们是不是迷路了？

sentences.en: Did the car break down?
sentences.zh: 汽车抛锚了吗？

sentences.en: Which way did they even go?
sentences.zh: 他们到底走的是哪条路？

sentences.en: Did they have an argument and one drive off without the other?
sentences.zh: 他们是不是吵架了然后其中一人把车开走丢下了另一个？

sentences.en: Were one or both of them injured and unable to go for help?
sentences.zh: 他们中有一个或两人受伤了而无法去求救吗？

sentences.en: Had they been taken by crocodiles?
sentences.zh: 他们被鳄鱼抓走了吗？

sentences.en: They only had one vehicle between the four of them and Lance and Marcus had it so the women couldn't go for a drive to search for them.
sentences.zh: 四个人之间只有一辆车，而且车在兰斯和马库斯那里，所以女人们没法开车去找他们。

sentences.en: As the morning turned into afternoon,
sentences.zh: 随着清晨转为下午，

sentences.en: Winifred and Joan contacted the Northern Territory Police at Timber Creek Station to report their husbands missing.
sentences.zh: 温妮弗雷德和琼联系了蒂姆伯克里克警局的北领地警察，报告她们的丈夫失踪。

sentences.en: Constable First Class Martin Plum and Constable Brett Thorpe were the two officers stationed at Timber Creek.
sentences.zh: 一级警员马丁·普拉姆和警员布雷特·索普是驻守在蒂姆伯克里克的两名警官。

sentences.en: After taking the missing persons report, they started searching the more well-known fishing spots in the area.
sentences.zh: 在记录了失踪人口报告后，他们开始搜寻该地区较为知名的钓鱼点。

sentences.en: But they found no trace of Marcus or Lance Bullen.
sentences.zh: 但他们没有发现任何关于马库斯或兰斯·布伦的踪迹。

sentences.en: Officers had a difficult task.
sentences.zh: 警员们面临着一项艰巨的任务。

sentences.en: The Judbra Gregory National Park is enormous.
sentences.zh: 朱布拉格雷戈里国家公园面积巨大。

sentences.en: It's the same size as the Greater Sydney Area,
sentences.zh: 它的面积与悉尼大都会区相当，

sentences.en: 13,000 square kilometres.
sentences.zh: 达到1.3万平方公里。

sentences.en: Marcus and Lance could have been anywhere.
sentences.zh: 马库斯和兰斯可能在任何地方。

sentences.en: With no sign of them, the search was called off when darkness fell.
sentences.zh: 由于毫无他们的踪迹，夜幕降临后搜寻工作只得取消。

sentences.en: Earlier that morning, when Marcus and Lance got out of their car at what they thought would be the ideal fishing spot along the Victoria River,
sentences.zh: 当天清晨，当马库斯和兰斯在他们认为维多利亚河沿岸理想钓鱼点的地方下车时，

sentences.en: there was someone watching them.
sentences.zh: 有人在暗中观察他们。

sentences.en: The tranquility of their surroundings was shattered within seconds when they were ambushed by a man brandishing a .223 rifle who ordered them to lie face down
sentences.zh: 周围的宁静在几秒钟内就被打破了，他们遭到了一名挥舞着.223口径步枪的男子伏击，该男子命令他们脸朝下趴在

sentences.en: next to their vehicle.
sentences.zh: 他们的汽车旁边。

sentences.en: Shocked and confused,
sentences.zh: 震惊和困惑之下，

sentences.en: Marcus and Lance obeyed the stranger.
sentences.zh: 马库斯和兰斯听从了陌生人的命令。

sentences.en: Before they could work out who the man was or which direction he'd come from, he shot them in the back in quick succession, killing both instantly.
sentences.zh: 还没等他们弄清楚这人是谁或他是从哪个方向来的，对方便迅速连续向他们的背部开枪，当场将两人杀害。

sentences.en: The killer stripped them both naked and dragged them by their feet to the high watermark in the riverbed where he dug two shallow graves on the sandy bank and pushed them in.
sentences.zh: 凶手剥光了两人的衣服，抓住他们的脚将他们拖到河床的高水位线处，在沙质河岸上挖了两个浅坑并将他们推了进去。

sentences.en: After burying their bodies, the killer threw the bullens' clothes and belongings into their station wagon.
sentences.zh: 埋好尸体后，凶手把布伦一家的衣服和随身物品扔进他们的旅行车。

sentences.en: The task of apprehending the person responsible was overwhelming, given the sheer size of the area.
sentences.zh: 鉴于案发区域之大，缉拿肇事者的任务令人感到无比棘手。
